title: The Moral Consistency Pipeline: Continuous Ethical Evaluation for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Autonomous generation of ethical scenarios spanning fairness, privacy, transparency, coercion, and alignment domains, evaluated continuously via a closed-loop framework (MoCoP). The system measures bias and fairness deviations using lexical integrity analysis (bias-weighted sentiment, polarity variance), semantic risk estimation (toxicity and harm quantification), and reasoning-based judgment modeling.
